comment: explode.c scatter() for a scattered object whose next square is off the map: a dwarven Valkyrie in debug mode wishes for 250 gold pieces, #wizloadlua Kni-strt lays the Knight quest home over Dlvl 1 (its mines-style init fills every column with floor), ^F maps it, ^T teleports her to column 1 (x=1), she drops the gold there, steps south, and kicks it north. dokick.c really_kick_object() -> scatter(x, y, rnd(3), VIS_EFFECTS | MAY_HIT, gold); chunks heading west reach x=0, so isok() fails, typ becomes STONE and the chunk stops in place.
